description: This file implements the LLMSwitcher class, which manages switching between multiple LLMService instances at runtime, supports inference, and function registration across those models. It is part of a larger pipeline handling LLM integrations.

classes.name: LLMSwitcher
classes.description: A pipeline component that manages switching between different LLMs during runtime, providing inference and function registration capabilities.

methods.name: __init__(self, llms: List[LLMService], strategy_type: Type[StrategyType])
methods.description: Initializes the LLMSwitcher with a list of LLMService objects and a strategy type.

methods.name: List[LLMService] llms(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of managed LLMService instances.

methods.name: Optional[LLMService] active_llm(self)
methods.description: Returns the currently active LLMService instance, or None if there is none active.

methods.name: Optional[str] run_inference(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Performs inference asynchronously using the currently active LLM with a provided context.

methods.name: register_function( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a function handler across all managed LLMs, handling function calls.

methods.name: register_direct_function( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler across all managed LLMs.

ctags.signature: ( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )

ctags.signature: ( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
